Engineer.description: An engineer on the rota. A first name alone is not an identity.

Service.description: A running service, named by its slug, independent of who looks after it.

Stewardship.description:
Who answers for a service: its owner, its escalation contact or someone shadowing it.
Shadowing a service is not owning it.

Pairing.description: A standing arrangement between two engineers: one mentors the other, or backs the other up on call.

Incident.description: An outage or degradation. reported_by raised it, responder fixed it, reviewer checks the postmortem.

Deploy.description: A change shipped to a service. author wrote it, approver signed it off; a planned deploy has not shipped.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Service)-[:owner]->(n1:Engineer) WHERE n0.slug = 'ledger-api' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: Which services are owned by me?
questions.speaker: bilal
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)-[:owned]->(n1:Service) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.slug AS slug

questions.speaker: ishaan_v
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)-[:mentor]->(n1:Engineer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name
MATCH (n0:Engineer)-[:mentee]->(n1:Engineer) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Amara Nwosu' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: Was the notify blip customer facing?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.summary = 'notify blip' RETURN n0.customer_facing AS customer_facing

questions.q: Is there a record that the retry tweak was behind a flag?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Deploy) WHERE n0.change = 'retry tweak' RETURN coalesce(n0.behind_flag, false) AS behind_flag

questions.q: What incidents did Ishaan Varma report?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)<-[:reported_by]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Ishaan Varma' RETURN n1.summary AS summary
MATCH (n0:Incident)-[:reviewer]->(n1:Engineer) WHERE n0.summary = 'search-indexer lag' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: Which deploys did Joon-ho Baek write?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)<-[:author]-(n1:Deploy) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Joon-ho Baek' RETURN n1.change AS change
MATCH (n0:Service)<-[:service]-(n1:Incident) WHERE n0.slug = 'checkout' AND n1.summary CONTAINS 'down' RETURN n1.minutes_down AS minutes_down

questions.q: What canary did the reindex batching change get?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Deploy) WHERE n0.change = 'reindex batching' RETURN n0.canary_percent AS canary_percent

questions.q: Who is the escalation contact for notify?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Service)-[:escalation]->(n1:Engineer) WHERE n0.slug = 'notify' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: What were the incidents I responded to?
questions.speaker: amara
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)<-[:responder]-(n1:Incident) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.summary AS summary
MATCH (n0:Incident) WHERE n0.summary CONTAINS 'checkout' RETURN n0.summary AS summary

questions.q: Which services are shadowed by me?
questions.speaker: mirela
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)-[:shadowed]->(n1:Service) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.slug AS slug

questions.speaker: kalani
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)<-[:approver]-(n1:Deploy) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.change AS change
MATCH (n0:Engineer)-[:backup]->(n1:Engineer) WHERE n0.display_name = 'Bilal Haddad' RETURN n1.display_name AS display_name

questions.q: What is the change and state of every deploy?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Deploy) RETURN n0.change AS change, n0.state AS state
